body.description: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.
item_descriptions: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. Clean pixel art with large smooth color areas, no noise, no dithering, no scattered single pixels. a long slender syringe-shaped specimen collector, tilted diagonally from lower left to upper right, about five times longer than it is wide, a slim glass cylinder held inside a thin polished blue-steel metal frame, with a long narrow glass window along its length showing the liquid, a flared metal cap at the top with a small round ring loop, thin ridged metal bands at both ends, a short stepped metal nozzle at the bottom with a blunt rounded tip. The metal frame is always the same plain cool blue-steel grey, never gold or yellow, the color and light belong only to the liquid. The glass tube is completely empty and transparent, clear glass with a few long white reflection lines, nothing inside, no glow, no sparkles.  Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
